quotes.text: We do only want people who are able to physically come to Columbus and present there. So, other than that, anyone is welcome to put in a proposal.
A birds of a feather session is an interactive sort of thing. It can take the form of a presentation that's maybe a little bit out of the normal scope of what it is.

None of the people who are on the staff or involved, none of us are getting paid to do this. It's an entirely volunteer thing and we do it because we love the community, we love learning and seeing a lot more about free software.

notes.summary: This episode covers the upcoming OLF (Open, Libra, Free) conference, returning to Ohio State University on November 20-21, 2026. Host Ken Fallon interviews conference chair Beth Lynn Eicher and speaker chair Vance Kogendurfer about the call for presentations, venue details, accessibility, and event structure. The show discusses presentation proposals, Birds of a Feather sessions, student involvement, and volunteer organization. It will interest open source enthusiasts, potential presenters, and those curious about community-run tech conferences.
